recipes.name: remaining-is-other
recipes.recipe: Keep one dynamic String b into two claims; SCon a consumes one as tail, other argument owns the second. Retain third b alias. Assert physical word equality parent.tail==other.

recipes.name: retained-in-other
recipes.recipe: One String b has parent Con head and other Con head edges plus an external b root. Parent is held shared. Rebuild Con k0; exact result [b,b], parent alias [b].

recipes.name: cross-layout-overlap
recipes.recipe: One String b is parent SCon tail and other Con head plus external b root. Shared parent ab. Rebuild Con k1; result [b,b], remaining Char97; preserves parent alias ab.

recipes.name: sealed-static-parent
recipes.recipe: Construct static ab and retain immortal observation. Put it inside dynamic Con to force rfc_seal(static), then take holder. Parent has heap RFC cell count1 but decoded object location below HEAP_OFF; reconstruction must allocate, preserve static ab.

recipes.name: last-owner-redirect
recipes.recipe: Keep dynamic ab root then drop one claim, leaving RFCbit1/count1. Other z stays unsealed. Rebuild can free old wrapper and reuse that class0 cell to seal z; all old child loads must precede free/reuse.

recipes.name: allocator-empty
recipes.recipe: Raw unique ab parent; other z unsealed. Allocate and retain padded q redirects through public APIs until class0 HOT==0 and LEN==0. Rebuild must refill through actual miss helper; release padding after semantic observations.

recipes.name: allocator-handoff
recipes.recipe: Last-owner RFC ab parent; other SNil immediate, so reconstruction needs no seal allocation. Prepare32768 public padding roots; release until class0 LEN32767. Parent wrapper free must hand off to COLD and leave HOT0/LEN0. Assert exact state before cleanup; then release surviving padding.
